topic: Making infographics with AI: building them as code (HTML and SVG) with Claude so the text stays sharp and editable, using an image generator for illustrations, combining both, and turning the method into a template or skill a team can reuse
audience: Professionals who make one-page visuals for reports, posts and presentations and want them clear, on-brand and easy to fix
goal: Build a first infographic as an editable Claude visual or artifact, add an illustration from an image tool where it helps, and save the method as a project or a skill the whole team can use
notes: Mojeed Abisiga is a data and AI leader and educator whose mission is to make data and AI easy for everyone; he teaches people to use AI at work, founded DataGlobal Hub and is a Forbes Technology Council member. [https://mojeedabisiga.com/]

Claude does not generate photos or illustrations the way image-generation tools do; it builds diagrams, charts and interactive visuals with HTML and SVG, and it can analyze images you upload. [https://support.claude.com/en/articles/9002504-can-claude-produce-images]

Claude can draw custom diagrams, charts and interactive visuals inline in a chat; the feature is in beta for all Claude users on web and desktop (chat and Cowork) and does not render in the iOS or Android apps (article dated 22 April 2026). [https://support.claude.com/en/articles/13979539-custom-visuals-in-chat-and-cowork]

Nothing needs turning on for custom visuals: Claude decides when a visual helps, or you can ask with phrases such as 'draw this as a diagram' or 'chart this data'. [https://support.claude.com/en/articles/13979539-custom-visuals-in-chat-and-cowork]

Custom visuals are built with HTML and are temporary by default; to keep one, use Copy as image, Download (as an .svg or .html file) or Save as artifact. [https://support.claude.com/en/articles/13979539-custom-visuals-in-chat-and-cowork]

An artifact is anything Claude makes that you'd put in front of someone (a design, deck, document, dashboard or small interactive tool); it opens beside the conversation and can be edited and shared. Artifacts are on all plans. [https://support.claude.com/en/articles/17153992-what-are-artifacts-and-how-do-i-use-them]

Artifact templates: Docs, Slides and Design on all plans; Data on paid plans; Sheets and Whiteboards in beta on paid plans; Motion in beta on Team and Enterprise. [https://support.claude.com/en/articles/17153992-what-are-artifacts-and-how-do-i-use-them]

Artifacts require the code execution and file creation setting ('Create and edit files' in the updated layout) to be on in Settings > Capabilities. [https://support.claude.com/en/articles/17153992-what-are-artifacts-and-how-do-i-use-them]

For artifacts made from a template, click 'Export': docs go to Word, PDF, Markdown or Google Docs; decks to PowerPoint or PDF, or straight to Google Slides; designs to .zip, PDF, PowerPoint or standalone HTML. [https://support.claude.com/en/articles/17153992-what-are-artifacts-and-how-do-i-use-them]

Artifacts start private. To share: open the artifact, click 'Share', choose who can open it under 'Who has access', then copy the link and send it. [https://support.claude.com/en/articles/9547008-share-artifacts]

In the help-center sharing table, 'Share with anyone who has the link' is ticked for Pro, Max, Ultra, Team and Enterprise but not Free. [https://support.claude.com/en/articles/9547008-share-artifacts]
Sharing settings can't be changed in Claude for iOS or Android; use Claude on the web or Claude Desktop. [https://support.claude.com/en/articles/9547008-share-artifacts]

Sharing an artifact that uses Claude costs the creator nothing: usage counts against each viewer's own plan limits. [https://support.claude.com/en/articles/17153992-what-are-artifacts-and-how-do-i-use-them]

Uploads to Claude: images JPEG, PNG, GIF and WebP, up to 8000x8000 pixels; documents include PDF, DOCX, CSV, TXT and XLSX; up to 20 files per chat. [https://support.claude.com/en/articles/8241126-upload-files-to-claude]
ChatGPT's plan table lists image generation as Limited on Free and included on Go, Plus and Pro. [https://chatgpt.com/pricing/]
ChatGPT's Images page says you can start generating images for free with a ChatGPT account; you must log in or sign up to create images. [https://chatgpt.com/images/]

In the Gemini app, the Nano Banana 2 image model (generation and editing) is free; Nano Banana 2.1 needs a Google AI plan. To make an image, select 'Create images' from the tools menu, then add a prompt or upload an image to edit. [https://gemini.google/overview/image-generation/]
Gemini images carry an invisible SynthID watermark and a visible watermark. [https://gemini.google/overview/image-generation/]
Gemini image generation can place clear text in images in many languages. [https://gemini.google/overview/image-generation/]

Projects are self-contained workspaces with their own chat histories and knowledge bases; they are available to all users, and Free users can create up to five. [https://support.claude.com/en/articles/9517075-what-are-projects]

To create a project, go to claude.ai/projects and click '+ New Project'; add files with '+' and instructions with 'Set project instructions'. [https://support.claude.com/en/articles/9519177-how-can-i-create-and-manage-projects]

Skills are folders of instructions, scripts and resources that Claude loads dynamically for specialized tasks; they are available on all plans and require code execution to be enabled. [https://support.claude.com/en/articles/12512176-what-are-skills]

A skill is a directory containing at minimum a SKILL.md file that starts with YAML frontmatter holding two required fields: name (up to 64 characters) and description (what it does and when to use it, up to 200 characters; Claude uses it to decide when to use the skill). Anthropic's own example is a Brand Guidelines skill that applies a company's colours, fonts and logo usage. [https://support.claude.com/en/articles/12512198-how-to-create-custom-skills]

To add a custom skill, package the skill folder as a ZIP, go to Customize > Skills, click '+', then '+ Create skill' and 'Upload a skill'. [https://support.claude.com/en/articles/12512180-use-skills-in-claude]
Plugins bundle skills, connectors and sub-agents into one package; they are on all paid plans. [https://support.claude.com/en/articles/13837440-use-plugins-in-claude]

Claude can create Excel, PowerPoint, Word and PDF files in a conversation; you can download them or save them directly to Google Drive. [https://support.claude.com/en/articles/12111783-create-and-edit-files-with-claude]
